name: related-issue-explorer
description: Search open and closed GitHub issues for overlap and read the target issue template plus a short repo slice. Read-only.

inputs.name: idea
inputs.description: Prompt text for a future implementation idea, or a pasted feature-brief.

inputs.name: intake-summary
inputs.description: Framed idea, resolved owner/name, issue kind, and matching form file when one exists.

outputs.name: overlap-report
outputs.description: Related open and closed issues with links, plus whether drafting must stop.

outputs.name: template-excerpt
outputs.description: Chosen form path, title prefix, labels, and required field labels.
